summary: This resolution expresses support for "National Public Lands Day" and encourages people to visit public lands on this fee-free day to recognize their value and economic contribution.

scores.thoughts: This resolution expresses support for National Public Lands Day and encourages visits to public lands, highlighting their role as hubs for biodiversity and treasured species. This implicitly supports environmental protection by promoting appreciation and conservation of these areas, though it doesn't introduce new regulations or policies.
